title: Le discours rapporté
summary: Rapporter ce que quelqu'un a dit : concordance des temps, changements de pronoms et d'indicateurs de temps.

blocks.text: Quand le verbe d'introduction est au passé (*said, told, asked*), on **recule d'un temps** :

head: Paroles directes
Discours rapporté
rows: prétérit continu : he said he was working
past perfect : he said he had worked
past perfect : he said he had worked

items: *say* + (to + personne) : *He said (to me) that he was tired.*
*tell* + personne : *He told me that he was tired.*

blocks.text: L'ordre redevient **affirmatif**, sans do/does/did : *She asked me where I lived.* Pour oui/non : *if / whether* : *He asked if I was ready.*

blocks.en: "I'm tired," he said. → He said he was tired.
blocks.fr: Il a dit qu'il était fatigué.

blocks.en: She told me she had finished.
blocks.fr: Elle m'a dit qu'elle avait fini.

blocks.en: He asked me where I worked.
blocks.fr: Il m'a demandé où je travaillais.

blocks.text: **Piège** : *He told that…* est faux. On dit *He told **me** that…* ou *He **said** that…*

exercises.q: "I am busy," she said. → She said she ___ busy.
"I will call," he said. → He said he ___ call.
"I have finished," he said. → He said he ___ finished.
'Where do you live?' → She asked me where ___.
He said he ___ (work) late. (« I work late »)
They said they ___ (can) help. (« we can »)
"I saw it yesterday." → He said he had seen it the day ___.
She asked me ___ I liked coffee. (oui/non)
Remets les mots dans le bon ordre.
answers: He said that he was tired

answers: She asked me where I worked
